create_analyzed_trace: create an AnalyzedTrace from torch Kineto profiling events to compute forward and backward flops per dtype
compute_hfu: compute hardware FLOPS utilization (HFU) from an AnalyzedTrace given hardware flop rates per dtype
compute_mfu: compute model FLOPS utilization (MFU) from an AnalyzedTrace accounting for backward recomputation overhead
calculate_attention_flops: calculate attention FLOPs for query and value tensor shapes with optional causal masking and format conversion
find_root_events: find root dispatch events with flops from a sequence of Kineto profiling events grouped by thread and device
